name: Aurora Deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch: {}
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.event_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  netlify:
    name: Deploy to Netlify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          cache: "pnpm"
          node-version: "lts/*"
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm build
      - name: Deploy to Netlify
        uses: nwtgck/actions-netlify@4cbaf4c08f1a7bfa537d6113472ef4424e4eb654 # v3.0.0
        with:
          publish-dir: "./dist"
          netlify-config-path: ./netlify.toml
          production-deploy: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          deploy-message: "Deploy from GitHub Actions"
          enable-pull-request-comment: true
          enable-commit-comment: false
          alias: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number && format('pr{0}', github.event.pull_request.number) }}
        env:
          NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          NETLIFY_SITE_ID: ${{ vars.NETLIFY_SITE_ID }}

{
    "name": "aurora",
    "private": true,
    "version": "0.0.0",
    "repository": {
        "type": "git",
        "url": "https://github.com/element-hq/aurora"
    },
    "type": "module",
    "scripts": {
        "dev": "vite",
        "build": "vite build",
        "lint:types": "tsc --noEmit",
        "preview": "vite preview",
        "tauri": "tauri",
        "ubrn:web:build:release": "ubrn build web --config ubrn.config.yaml --release",
        "ubrn:web:build": "ubrn build web --config ubrn.config.yaml",
        "ubrn:checkout": "ubrn checkout --config ubrn.config.yaml",
        "ubrn:clean": "rm -Rf cpp/ src/generated/ src/index.web.ts*",
        "biome:format": "pnpm biome format --write ."
    },
    "dependencies": {
        "@element-hq/web-shared-components": "0.2.2",
        "@tauri-apps/api": "^1.6.0",
        "@vector-im/compound-design-tokens": "^11.2.0",
        "@vector-im/compound-web": "^10.3.0",
        "async-mutex": "^0.4.1",
        "classnames": "^2.5.1",
        "lodash-es": "^4.18.1",
        "react": "^19.3.0",
        "react-dom": "^19.3.0",
        "react-focus-lock": "^2.13.7",
        "react-virtuoso": "^4.18.16",
        "sanitize-html": "^2.18.0",
        "uniffi-bindgen-react-native": "github:jhugman/uniffi-bindgen-react-native#3dd1cd1353750dc3bfbbf4bb4d4ccde26b0fbd2e"
    },
    "devDependencies": {
        "@biomejs/biome": "2.0.6",
        "@tauri-apps/cli": "^1.6.3",
        "@types/lodash-es": "^4.17.12",
        "@types/react": "^19.3.0",
        "@types/react-dom": "^19.3.0",
        "@types/sanitize-html": "^2.16.2",
        "@vitejs/plugin-react": "^4.7.0",
        "typescript": "^5.9.3",
        "vite": "^5.4.21",
        "vite-plugin-top-level-await": "^1.6.0"
    },
    "devEngines": {
        "packageManager": {
            "name": "pnpm",
            "version": "11.23.0",
            "onFail": "download"
        }
    }
}
